name: agent-swarm-orchestration
description: Designs, composes, and adapts temporary agent organizations while preserving authority, evidence, state custody, and accountable closure.

interface.shortDescription: Design and adapt accountable agent organizations.
interface.longDescription: Shape the temporary organization a task actually needs: differentiate causal contributions, choose information and authority relations, compile each phase into a safe execution regime, adapt from evidence, and reconcile one accountable result without mistaking role costumes or agent chatter for competence.
defaultPrompt: Shape the temporary agent organization this work needs, compile its next phase safely, and adapt it from evidence.
Design causally distinct contributions and relations for this problem without treating familiar swarm patterns as a closed taxonomy.
Recover or reorganize this collaboration from the first unearned edge while preserving accepted evidence and authority.
